'''Shaptives''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in its final years as a member of the [[Jedi Starfighter Corps]]. A [[Jedi ace]], Shaptives was an acquaintance of the young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] when he joined the Order in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
Brought to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] at a young age like most of his contemporaries, Shaptives graduated from the [[Jedi academy]] and was eventually [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|knighted]] following his successful completion of the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. As a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]], Shaptives pursued study in the ways of the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Guardians]], becoming a [[Jedi ace|ace pilot]] and joining the [[Jedi Starfighter Corps]]. Ascending to the rank of Master, Shaptives met the young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Hearing of Skywalker's successful assault on a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]], Master Shaptives presented Skywalker with an honorary patch worn by members of the Corps.<ref name="TJP" />
